Thanks Hannah — we had a productive exec alignment this morning and are excited to move forward. Two quick asks before we lock dates: 1) can you send a mutual action plan (MAP) that splits milestones between Pinewave and Redwood? 2) we need an initial implementation timeline for procurement to validate resource windows.

High-level constraints from our side:
- Security review: target completion by 2026-09-24
- Data ingestion window: earliest 2026-10-04
- Go-live target: end of October (ideally 2026-10-29)

I copied Marissa since she will be our CS contact on the program. If you can share a document with milestones, owners, and suggested dates, we can route procurement and legal on our side.

Thanks,

Ethan — thanks for the clear constraints. Draft MAP attached (Pinewave_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) with milestone owners and three cadence options (conservative / targeted / accelerated). High-level proposed timeline (targeted):

1) Security questionnaire & evidence share (Pinewave: provide answers; Redwood: supply SOC2 artifacts) — 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-20 — Owners: Lina (Pinewave), Hannah (Redwood)
2) Provisioning & sandbox ingest (Pinewave: sample data; Redwood: sandbox build) — 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-03 — Owners: Lina, Jordan
3) Integration sprint 1 (core API + basic mapping) — 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-14 — Owners: Jordan (Redwood), Pinewave Eng
4) Validation & QA (end-to-end) — 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-22 — Owners: Marissa (Redwood), Pinewave QA
5) Cutover prep & Go/No-go — 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-28 — Owners: Hannah + Pinewave exec
6) Go-live — 2026-10-29

Key asks for Pinewave to unblock dates:
- Signed SOW or PO by 2026-09-10 (procurement window)
- Security questionnaire returned by 2026-09-10 to keep on targeted path
- 3 sample CSVs for ingestion by 2026-09-20

I attached the draft SOW as well (SOW_Pinewave_draft.pdf) to expedite procurement. Please review the attached MAP and tell us which cadence you prefer (conservative/targeted/accelerated). If targeted works, we’ll schedule a kickoff for Wed 2026-09-22.

Thanks — Hannah

Jordan Blake (internal):
- We can support the targeted timeline but need to reserve two focused sprints (10/04-10/14, 10/18-10/22). I recommend the following owners/responsibilities in the MAP: 
  - Integration lead (Redwood): Jordan Blake
  - CS lead (Redwood): Marissa Cole
  - Product owner (Pinewave): Ethan Cole

Operational notes:
- Sandbox build requires a short IP allowlist; we'll send the firewall template by Friday 09/04.
- If procurement misses 9/10, the earliest sensible kickoff slides 2 weeks (new go-live ~11/12).

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Pinewave to confirm preferred cadence by 9/04.
2) Pinewave procurement to upload PO to this thread or to marissa_cole@redwood.com by 9/10.
3) Jordan will share a tentative engineering roster and effort estimate by 9/06.

Happy to jump on a 30-min sync if helpful.

—Marissa

Thanks team — targeted cadence looks good. Confirming a few items from procurement and security: 
- Procurement: PO attached (Pinewave_PO_20260907.pdf). Finance will route a countersigned SOW after legal confirms the standard terms.
- Security: Lina will send the completed questionnaire by EOD 2026-09-09.

2) Are there rate-limit guardrails we should assume for the sandbox (tokens/sec) so our engs can plan throttling?

Ethan

Perfect — thanks for the PO, Ethan. Quick answers and next steps: 
- Integration test approach: Redwood will provide a test harness and Postman collection for API smoke/regression. Pinewave can run tests in your sandbox and we’ll run a mirrored test during validation to confirm parity. Jordan will share the harness + collection by 2026-09-14.
- Sandbox guardrails: Default sandbox limits will be 50 requests/min with burst up to 200 for short spikes — Jordan, will create a per-account throttling profile and share details.

Action items captured and owners: 
- Pinewave: return security questionnaire (Lina) — due 2026-09-09 (status: pending, Lina will upload)
- Pinewave: upload signed PO (Ethan) — completed 2026-09-07 (attachment present)
- Redwood: provide firewall template (Jordan) — due 2026-09-04 (in progress)
- Redwood: deliver test harness + Postman collection (Jordan) — due 2026-09-14
- Redwood CS: schedule kickoff (Marissa) — target 2026-09-22

I also created a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot deal record for the MAP (links below). Please review the attached MAP and SOW, and reply here if any dates need adjusting. If everyone is aligned, Marissa — feel free to set the kickoff invite for 09/22 11:00 AM PT.
